🌿 Branching model: trunk
   Long-lived branches : main
   Work branches       : feat/, fix/, docs/, ... from 'main', pull requests into 'main'
   Release candidate   : vX.Y.Z-rc.N tagged on 'main' after the version bump; fixes found in acceptance go into 'main' and a new candidate
   Release gate (user) : the user runs the promote workflow for the accepted candidate; it tags that commit vX.Y.Z and releases it
   Hotfix              : fix/<slug> into 'main', patch bump, candidate, promote; when 'main' holds unreleased work, hotfix/X.Y.Z from the release tag, the fix by pull request into it, candidate tagged there, then the fix into 'main' by pull request
